meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Small borrowal accounts (credit limits up to ₹2 lakh) by state and occupation, every quarter since March 2014
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 964 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. 54376 cells the source prints more than once with different values (2018-12-31, 2020-06-30, 2021-03-31, 2019-03-31 and other dates) are left out: we cannot tell which value is right. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (Arunachal Pradesh, Personal Credit Cards, credit limits on 2016-03-01).
